detail: Added explicit review-state predicate; REVIEW_REQUIRED and DEGRADED can preserve warning-only state only when unverified.
Positive tests for REVIEW_REQUIRED and DEGRADED; negative tests for verified, FAILED, BLOCKED, missing and null states.
Set cancel-in-progress false so newer commits do not cancel long acceptance jobs.
PR checks queued/pending at time of ledger update.
Render service is Free, main branch, auto-deploy enabled; current live revision differs from PR #49 candidate.
Protected documents absent from candidate tree and accessible Library. Do not recreate or mutate; historical SHA-256 values are recorded in ADR-0001.
